name: Partiturmaker
tagline: AI classical sheet music generator and audio-to-score tool
description: Partiturmaker is a browser-based AI tool for classical sheet music. Pick an era (Baroque, Classical or Romantic), one of 62 composer styles and one of six ensemble types, or describe the piece in a sentence, and each run produces a new score. It can also transcribe a recording, link or microphone input into single-line MusicXML. Five tools are free without an account; the generator and audio features use credits.
